slides.headline: Tech News You Need Today
slides.subtitle: From Apple's shifting launch dates to major changes at Amazon and Twitch.

slides.headline: Why Japan is slow on AI
slides.explanation: Japanese businesses are lagging in AI adoption due to a deep-seated culture of risk aversion. This hesitation could impact the country's competitiveness in the global tech market.

slides.headline: Discord faces Brazil livestream ban
slides.explanation: Brazil's data protection agency has ordered Discord to suspend its streaming features. The company says it is reviewing the order while maintaining its focus on user safety.

slides.headline: Apple's split iPhone 18 launch
slides.explanation: Reports suggest the base iPhone 18 will not arrive until early next year while the Pro models launch this fall. This change could disrupt how you plan your next phone upgrade.

slides.headline: Amazon trains AI on Twitch clips
slides.explanation: Amazon is using Twitch content to train its AI models by default unless streamers opt out. A company executive admitted that making this an opt-in feature would likely result in no one participating.

slides.headline: Google's 2026 hardware vision
slides.explanation: Google is prioritizing AI features over raw hardware specs for its upcoming Pixel 11 and Watch 5 lineup. It shows a clear shift toward software-led experiences for future devices.

title: Global News Briefing for August 12

slides.headline: Global News Briefing for August 12
slides.subtitle: From Zimbabwe to the UK, here are five stories shaping the world today.

slides.headline: Nike DEI Probe Ends
slides.explanation: Federal regulators dropped their subpoena against Nike after the company handed over requested diversity policy documents. It marks the end of a specific enforcement action regarding the brand's workplace practices.

slides.headline: Ferry Tragedy in Zimbabwe
slides.explanation: At least 44 people died after a ferry sank in Lake Kariba following heavy waves. It is a sobering reminder of the dangers posed by severe weather to local travel.

slides.headline: Heat Crisis Hits Hospitals
slides.explanation: Nurses are collapsing on the job as extreme heat makes hospital conditions difficult to endure. The union is now demanding better air conditioning to keep both staff and patients safe.

slides.headline: Myanmar Ex-Ambassador on Trial
slides.explanation: Kyaw Zwar Minn is facing trespassing charges for refusing to leave his diplomatic residence after being ousted in 2021. The case highlights the ongoing fallout from Myanmar's military coup.

slides.headline: The President's Decoy Flight
slides.explanation: Security concerns involving Iran led Trump to swap planes during a NATO summit in Turkey. His cabinet members stayed on the original aircraft while he made a quiet exit on a different jet.
